_comment: HELLFALL greybox styling. Every tint, light, label, marker and layout-spacing number used by Tools/ue/hf_geometry.py lives here; the scripts contain no styling literals. RGB values are linear 0-1. Geometry dimensions (walls, doors, ducts, figure size, label height/size for rooms) come from Data/metrics.json; player body values from Data/movement.json. Change here, rerun Tools/test_dry_run.ps1, then rebuild the map.

tints._comment: Each tint becomes ONE material asset /Game/Greybox/Materials/M_GB_<key>. 'opacity' < 1 makes the material translucent (markers and glass only).

wall_tint_by_role._comment: Room role -> wall tint key. Roles not listed use 'wall'.

labels._comment: Room label size and height come from metrics.architecture.label_world_size_cm / label_height_above_floor_cm (the room label is clamped one text height below the room light: with lights.drop_below_ceiling_cm 60 a 310 cm room reads at 210, a 280 cm restroom at 180). Colors are linear RGB 0-1. Every label is ONE single-sided TextRender turned toward where the player reads it from (VERIFIED 5.8.2 packaged-run frames 2026-09-06: a TextRender reads from its local +X side and is mirrored from behind; the old double_sided 180-degree twin overlapped it into garbled glyphs, so double_sided is retired - do not set it). Room / note / marker labels face the room's entry point (player start; else the opening from the previous critical-path room, duct mouth included; else a door or open to a critical-path room, corridors first; else the duct mouth; else -plan.y), snapped to the nearest 90 deg only within 10 deg. Wall labels (LOCKED / ELEVATOR / DUCT / WINDOW WALL / COLLAPSED) face into the room; feel-gym labels face the start (-y). wall_offset_cm = distance from a wall face for the wall labels; LOCKED is placed on every enterable side of the door. note.wrap_chars = word-wrap width for NOTE labels (TextRender has no wrapping).

lights._comment: One PointLight per room as an EVEN FILL light, MOVABLE so the greybox lights without a lighting build (iGPU: shadows off, counts small). Packaged-run finding 2026-09-06: ceiling-hung inverse-square candela lights blew the ceiling around each fixture out to white while the walls read flat tan, and auto-exposure swallowed a 12.5x candela change - so every point light (rooms, duct, feel-gym enclosures) has inverse-square falloff OFF, a unitless intensity_unitless (ELightUnits::Unitless; intensity_cd is retired and the generator refuses it), falloff_exponent (2.0; per-spec override allowed) and hangs drop_below_ceiling_cm under the ceiling (60: further from the slab shrinks the hot spot). Attenuation = max(min_attenuation_radius_cm, attenuation_diagonal_factor * room diagonal); the factor 1.25 puts the whole room inside the radius. Greybox-visibility values so Rob can judge space, not Gate 3 mood; temperature_k stays per role.

reference_figure._comment: Body box = metrics width x depth x (height - head_cm); head cube of head_cm on top; total = metrics.reference_figure_height_cm exactly.

player_start._comment: PlayerStart Z = movement.player.stand_height_cm / 2 + spawn_clearance_cm so the capsule bottom sits just above the floor.

encounter_marker._comment: Translucent flat boxes, visible, no collision. lift_cm keeps them above the floor to avoid z-fighting. lane_width_cm is the drawn width of retreat/strafe lanes.

collapse._comment: Floor-to-ceiling rubble wedge: 'tiers' stacked boxes, each tier's depth = blocker.depth_cm * depth_fractions[tier], flush against the far wall. Bottom tier is deepest so the wedge leans away from the player. label_offset_cm = label distance in front of the wedge.

window._comment: Glass slab from metrics window_sill_height_cm to window_head_height_cm, split into panes by a mullion every mullion_spacing_cm.

boundary._comment: Invisible collision-only shell around the plan bounds: four walls + lid + bottom, plus a safety slab whose top is safety_slab_below_floor_cm under Z=0. Wall height from metrics.architecture.boundary_wall_height_cm.

feel_gym._comment: Layout of /Game/Maps/L_FeelGym. Stations are laid out left to right along plan x in rows; row k sits at y = row_y_cm[k]. The player starts at start_y_cm facing +y (Unreal +X) and walks +y, so every gym label is single-sided facing -y (toward the start), inside labels included. Element dimensions come from metrics.feel_gym; only spacing/layout lives here. Jump ledges are separated by element_gap_cm of floor (each is jumped onto from the ground), which is why slab_d_cm is 4400: 5 ledges x (200 + 140) from y 2600 + station_gap_cm. The sun and sky light stay (outdoor gym); enclosed_light / tunnel_light are the same even fill point lights as the office (intensity_unitless, inverse-square off, lights.falloff_exponent).
